🎃 FRIGHT NIGHT UPDATE: MY PLAYER IS HERE!
👍 Like and favorite for more updates!

⚽ RFC 27 is next-gen football (soccer) on Roblox: real ball physics, one-touch passing, skill moves and broadcast-style matches.

⭐ MY PLAYER: create your pro, pick your position and play live 7v7 matches with players from every server. Level up, earn skill points and chase 99 overall.
🏆 ONLINE SEASONS: climb 10 divisions to Elite.
🃏 DREAM SQUAD: open packs, build your ultimate team, complete squad challenges.
🎮 Plus Quick Match, Player & Manager Career, Tournaments, Skill Games and a full tutorial.

🎃 FRIGHT NIGHT (until Nov 8): Fright Pass, candy shop, Fright crate and Halloween gear.

📱 Built for phone, tablet, controller and keyboard.
🎁 Codes: FRIGHTNIGHT • MYPLAYER • RFC27
⭐ Roblox Premium: +10% match coins and +25 gems every day.
💬 Join our Discord and group: links under Social Links below!
💎 Optional store. Drop rates are always shown before you open.
